name: Browser Skins
description: A clean new tab page that displays wallpapers and dynamically generates a matching Firefox theme based on extracted colors. The extension replaces the new tab page and sets itself as the homepage to provide a consistent visual experience across tabs. The applied theme updates automatically based on the selected wallpaper. Recently visited and most-visited sites are read from your local browsing history to populate the quick-access row. The homepage setting can be changed at any time in Firefox settings. No other data is collected or transmitted.
author: KinetixSyntax
